## Summary

Adds `VLLM_RAY_PG_STRATEGY` to make the Ray placement group strategy configurable when vLLM creates a placement group.

The environment variable defaults to `PACK` to preserve the existing behavior and accepts:

- `PACK`
- `SPREAD`
- `STRICT_PACK`
- `STRICT_SPREAD`

The value is validated with the existing `env_with_choices()` helper and passed to `ray.util.placement_group()` in `initialize_ray_cluster`.

Fixes #49527.

## Why this is not a duplicate

Before opening this PR, I checked open PRs referencing #49527, open PRs containing `VLLM_RAY_PG_STRATEGY`, and open PRs related to configurable Ray placement group strategy.

I did not find an existing open PR implementing this feature.

## Testing

Passed locally:

```text
python -m py_compile vllm/envs.py vllm/v1/executor/ray_utils.py tests/test_envs.py
```

Targeted validation confirmed:

- default strategy is `PACK`
- `PACK`, `SPREAD`, `STRICT_PACK`, and `STRICT_SPREAD` are accepted
- invalid values are rejected
- `initialize_ray_cluster` uses `envs.VLLM_RAY_PG_STRATEGY`

Lint checks passed:

```text
pre-commit run ruff-check --files vllm/envs.py vllm/v1/executor/ray_utils.py tests/test_envs.py
pre-commit run ruff-format --files vllm/envs.py vllm/v1/executor/ray_utils.py tests/test_envs.py
git diff --check
```

I was not able to run the full `pytest tests/test_envs.py` suite locally because the Windows environment does not have the full vLLM test dependency set installed. Test collection progressed past `tblib` and then stopped on the missing `regex` dependency. Repository CI will provide the full test-environment validation.

## AI assistance

AI tools were used for implementation assistance and code completion. All changes were manually reviewed and validated.
